name: gemmein-for-business
description: Build and run your business app from ChatGPT: a hosted site with customer sign-in, private customer data and payments into your own Stripe. Live changes only with your approval.

interface.longDescription:
Gemmein for Business lets you build and run the app your business needs, just by describing it. Tell ChatGPT what you want to create (a booking page that takes deposits, a members' area, a private client portal) and it builds it on Gemmein: hosted, with customers signing in by a code sent to their email, each person's data kept private, and payments going straight into your own Stripe account.

You start in Development, with a private preview that updates as ChatGPT builds. When you're ready, you put it live for your customers. Nothing reaches your live customers without you: every change to Live is approved by you in the browser.

Once you're live, ask how your business is doing (new customers, revenue, messages, errors) and ChatGPT answers from your Gemmein dashboard. Your customers' personal details stay hidden from the AI unless you turn them on.
defaultPrompt: Build a booking page for my studio that takes a deposit.
Make a members-only area for my course where people sign in with their email.
How is my business doing today? Any new customers or messages?
